assessment: 2026-10-18 / single-maintainer policy; see assessment for scope and verification limits

claims.title: Data processing and confidentiality
claims.statement: The browser application parses imported engineering files and calculates results locally using JavaScript and a Pyodide worker. Its data-confidentiality policy prohibits sending imported data, identifying metadata or derived outputs over a network.
claims.scope: Browser release architecture; policy is a requirement, not proof of all execution paths.
claims.limitation: Runtime observations cover exercised flows; compromised code or endpoints remain outside this statement.

claims.title: Network connectivity
claims.statement: Application code, fonts and fixed runtime libraries are served from the application origin. Opening the site requires connectivity; the hosting service and network infrastructure receive ordinary asset-request information. Local file processing is distinct from resource downloading.
claims.limitation: Offline operation after a cold start is not guaranteed; caches are browser managed.

claims.title: Data storage and retention
claims.statement: Selected files and calculations use browser memory and the worker virtual filesystem. Named workspaces and network layouts can persist in localStorage; interface preferences use sessionStorage. To remove retained site data, use your browser’s site-data controls for this origin and reload. Manage exported files separately.
claims.scope: Browser storage calls in the reviewed source.
claims.limitation: Clearing site data can also clear other applications on the same origin. Closing a tab does not erase downloads, caches or saved layouts.

claims.title: Application security controls
claims.statement: The source confidentiality gate detects changes to reviewed network-capable files. Dependency files are checked against a maintained hash inventory. Browser request tests reject unapproved destinations, resource queries, request bodies and network sockets in tested flows. These checks require enforced repository checks and release rules to prevent bypass.
claims.limitation: Source scanning is a conservative change detector, not a sandbox. Repository enforcement is a separate administrator setting.

claims.title: Software dependencies
claims.statement: Runtime components include Pyodide for Python execution, NumPy and pandas for analysis, Plotly for charts, SheetJS for association workbooks and Inter for typography. Their maintained inventory records versions, hashes and licence files. Dependency changes require security and compatibility review.
claims.limitation: An inventory and matching hashes do not establish absence of vulnerabilities or a licence approval.

claims.title: Security verification
claims.statement: Verification status is not available for this build. Release checks cover source confidentiality, dependency advisories, secrets, static analysis, engineering regression and browser requests. This is a single-maintainer project: independent human review is not available, and AI-assisted review is not a substitute. Version and source revision identify the build; consult workflow evidence for that revision.
claims.limitation: No independent human approval, certification or runtime security badge is claimed. Mandatory checks and effective branch rules are required before deployment.

claims.title: Limitations and responsible use
claims.statement: Tests cover defined workflows and supported desktop browsers. Browser extensions, endpoint security and subsequent handling of exported files remain outside the application’s control. Apply your organisation’s data-handling requirements. Passing tests is not a universal security guarantee.
claims.scope: Desktop browser support and assurance boundary.
claims.limitation: No organisational approval or certification is implied.

claims.title: Security issues and reporting
claims.statement: Follow the security disclosure guidance. Do not place confidential datasets, credentials or sensitive evidence in public issues. Use an established private channel to the repository owner.
claims.limitation: No private contact address is invented; an established channel is needed.
